# REDTEAM #160 (SPEC Sec 3.4, T-304; IMPLEMENTATION.md M20-S1): Go pointer
# validity under moving modes stays an M20 gate requirement, not a passing
# claim. The fast path holds only the top-level word with a foreign-hold
# bracket; Pinner-pinned, conservatively scanned, and pointer-keyed-map-key
# objects are excluded by the pin pass, not by slots. The M diagnostics
# (flag, timestamp, slots) MUST read zero after return without clearing the
# caller's argument values. This script pins the diagnostic half in the
# default build and the evacuation half in an immix-linked test binary (heap
# objects can move only when the linker selects a moving mode, the same
# linkage buildLogosMove uses). The phase gates stay closed, so the row
# stays planned (parent owns the ledger).
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Diagnostic contract, no experiment: enter records the argument frame, the
# start stamp, and the flag; exit clears all three to zero.
go test -v -count=1 -run 'TestCgoFastcallPinSlots' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestCgoFastcallPinSlots'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
go test -race -v -count=1 -run 'TestCgoFastcallPinSlots' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestCgoFastcallPinSlots'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'

# Evacuation half: the in-flight fast-call argument must not move.
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go test -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=immix -count=1 -run 'TestLogosFastCallPinSurvivesEvacuation' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFastCallPinSurvivesEvacuation'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
go test -race -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=immix -count=1 -run 'TestLogosFastCallPinSurvivesEvacuation' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosFastCallPinSurvivesEvacuation'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam160

go 1.27
